issue_request: FHIR-18873 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 Pharmacy change request to fix codelist use for Medication.status; MedicationKnowledge status, characteristics, and packageType; MedicationDispense status, category, statusReason, and performerFunction; MedicationAdministration status, category, and performerFunction; and MedicationRequest status, intent, category, statusReason, and courseOfTherapy.
initial_application: Jira records a 2018-10-03 vote and a 2018-10-10 comment that the change was committed to master. Git history shows the issue-tagged a17996e1980a4ebe80f890436404cae69bd4a38d for Medication and MedicationDispense codelists; 7373e742ee4ae5907dc0d8b0779cadb0cb0892f0, which appears to typo the key as GF 18773 while adding related Pharmacy codelists; 51ce8a822f639be478cea8655beab71f95afb6ab changing status/intent datatypes to code; and 238047ddf441d945f3809d267cec534ec8282abc fixing the MedicationStatement status canonical URI.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps Medication, MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, and MedicationStatement active in the current build. MedicationKnowledge residual files remain, but 5a4307d78b0209f61bbc68d582c1e190b3aaee5c removed MedicationKnowledge from the active resource list; before that, FHIR-31633 and FHIR-45285 later changed its status terminology trail, with FHIR-45285 requiring publication-status for interface compatibility. No relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The active current pharmacy StructureDefinitions already have explicit valueSet bindings for the requested status, intent, category, reason, performer function, and course-of-therapy elements, and the associated terminology files or THO references are present. MedicationKnowledge is out of current build scope, so its residual source should not be edited for this STU3 issue.
